gen-gf-zcool-kuaile-fs-literata: ZCOOL KuaiLe draws its horizontals and verticals at matching heft, with joins that never thin out where strokes meet. Literata, a text serif, moves through paragraphs gently, its stroke contrast modest.
gen-gf-zcool-qingke-huangyou-fs-literata: Pipe-thick strokes, snug together: that's ZCOOL QingKe HuangYou. Literata underneath is a text serif whose gentle contrast only shows up close, so let its size run a touch larger.
gen-gf-zcool-xiaowei-fs-literata: Literata reads bookish and sophisticated, its curves leaving wide mouths between sturdy strokes. And the sans heading ZCOOL XiaoWei, tapering from stem to terminal, gives that texture a friendly, contemporary face.
gen-gf-zen-antique-fs-bespoke-sans: Ribbon-fat stems and thread-thin hairlines: Zen Antique is all showy contrast. Bespoke Sans then reads sharp and refined, its open curves letting a long run of text move easily.
gen-gf-zen-antique-soft-fs-bespoke-sans: Heavy ink-black strokes share each letter with gossamer hairlines in Zen Antique Soft. That one is best at literary authority; Bespoke Sans is best at sharp, refined clarity, with generous gaps by its stems.
gen-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-antique-fs-litera: Literata, a bookish serif, shifts its stroke weight noticeably but never dramatically. Yet Zen Kaku Gothic Antique holds a constant, unshaded stroke, and that steadiness against the serif's shifts is the real draw.
gen-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-new-fs-literata: Literata sits in the middle ground, neither monoline nor sharply contrasted. Zen Kaku Gothic New holds one fixed pressure through every curve, while the serif's gentle shifts carry the eye through paragraphs.
gen-gf-zilla-slab-highlight-fs-bespoke-s: Zilla Slab Highlight sets black stems like iron bars against silk-fine hairlines. Bespoke Sans stays low in contrast with generous space by each stem, giving all that drama a sharp, quiet partner.
gen-ibm-plex-serif-fs-bespoke-sans: Slightly slimmer horizontals give IBM Plex Serif its literary bite. Bespoke Sans then carries the reading with low contrast and generous space between curve ends and stems, so text flows smoothly.
gen-metal-mania-bitter: Bitter reads dependable and grounded, a slab-serif with big lowercase eyes. Metal Mania, all heavy, tightly packed strokes, would lose its bite if made small, so let it stay big.
